result.summary: The pedestrian environment includes sidewalks and a signalized intersection, but safety is compromised by faded crosswalk markings and uneven pavement. The presence of embedded trolley tracks and cobblestone sections introduces significant trip hazards and accessibility challenges.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway create a trip hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard for cyclists, especially when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the main roadway running parallel to the sidewalk

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk across the side street is severely worn, reducing its visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Crossing the side street adjacent to the stone building

hazards.name: Uneven Cobblestone Pavement
hazards.description: The transition to cobblestones creates an uneven walking surface that can be difficult for individuals with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area between the tracks and the side street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded markings with continental-style high-visibility crosswalks to improve driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Pavement Leveling and Repair
interventions.description: Level the pavement around the tracks and cobblestone areas to ensure a continuous, accessible path of travel.

result.summary: The urban environment features continuous sidewalks and signalized intersections with pedestrian signals. However, the presence of embedded trolley tracks and faded crosswalk markings increases the risk of trips and reduces driver awareness.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery and create a trip hazard for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is significantly worn, making it less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner may block the view between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines by preventing parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and curb ramps, but suffers from faded crosswalk markings and uneven cobblestone pavement. The lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and the presence of visual obstructions from parked cars further reduce the safety of the environment.
